# Security in Context

> > Security in Context challenges militarized security paradigms by centering Global South perspectives, human well-being, and solidarity over sanctions and counterinsurgency.

Founded by scholars including Omar Dahi, Security in Context produces research, policy papers, and the Insecurity Monitor publication series examining conflicts in Palestine, the Middle East, Latin America, and beyond through frameworks of decolonization, multipolarity, and global capitalism.

## Key Topics

- Global South security studies
- Palestine-Israel conflict and genocide
- Middle East geopolitics
- Multipolarity and global order
- Counterinsurgency critique
- Security pedagogy and reframing
- Latin America (Venezuela, regional dynamics)
- U.S. foreign policy
- Gaza humanitarian crisis
- Syria conflict
- China and emerging powers
- Sanctions and economic coercion
- Decolonial security frameworks
- Global capitalism and militarism
- Insecurity Monitor publication

## Core Framework & Mission

- [Security in Context](https://www.securityincontext.org/): Homepage promoting human well-being over militarism in security policy
- [Mission](https://www.securityincontext.org/about-3): Mission statement on alternative security and global solidarity
- [Redefining (In)Security](https://www.securityincontext.org/redefining-inecurity): Core framework redefining security beyond militarism and sanctions

- [Research](https://www.securityincontext.org/research): Research on Global South security, Gaza, and multipolarity perspectives
